officialText:
The commissioner shall have the discretion to require that any document or payment submitted to the department be submitted and/or signed electronically.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
